title: MADJEPA: Enhanced Multi-Stage Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Medical Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.25194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Anomaly detection in medical images is a complex task, requiring the development of a robust model using only healthy patient data. Without access to labeled data, modern approaches typically employ self-supervised learning to obtain a model of normality. Since world models promise to build strong internal representations of their environment, we consider them as suitable candidates for the medical anomaly detection environment, namely medical investigations of healthy patients. To this end, we propose MADJEPA, a medical anomaly detector based on an enhanced multi-stage joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). We design a multi-stage training pipeline to produce a robust detector: (1) image-based JEPA (I-JEPA) training aims to learn a strong representation of normal training data; (2) target encoder distillation aims to modulate over-generalization of I-JEPA representations to abnormal data; (3) pseudo-anomaly classification aim

translated_title: MADJEPA：用于医学异常检测的增强型多阶段联合嵌入预测架构
translated_abstract: 医学图像中的异常检测是一项复杂的任务，需要仅使用健康患者的数据来开发一个鲁棒的模型。在无法获得标注数据的情况下，现代方法通常采用自监督学习来获得正常性的模型。由于世界模型有望为其环境构建强大的内部表征，我们认为它们是医学异常检测环境（即对健康患者的医学检查）的合适候选。为此，我们提出了MADJEPA，一种基于增强型多阶段联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的医学异常检测器。我们设计了一个多阶段训练流程来构建鲁棒的检测器：（1）基于图像的JEPA（I-JEPA）训练旨在学习正常训练数据的强表征；（2）目标编码器蒸馏旨在调节I-JEPA表征对异常数据的过度泛化；（3）伪异常分类旨在……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了MADJEPA，一种基于增强型多阶段联合嵌入预测架构的医学图像异常检测器，通过I-JEPA训练、目标编码器蒸馏和伪异常分类的多阶段训练流程，仅使用健康患者数据即可学习正常性的强表征并实现鲁棒的异常检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MADJEPA, a medical anomaly detector based on an enhanced multi-stage joint-embedding predictive architecture, which learns strong representations of normality and achieves robust anomaly detection using only healthy patient data through a multi-stage training pipeline of I-JEPA training, target encoder distillation, and pseudo-anomaly classification.
